arxiv-2107-11086.title: Remarks on partially abelian exact categories
arxiv-2107-11086.creator: Theo Bühler
arxiv-2107-11086.description: Abstract . The purpose of this short and elementary note is to identify some classes of exact categories introduced in L. Previdi’s thesis. Among other things we show: (i) An exact category is partially abelian exact if and only if it is abelian.

arxiv-2206-03384.title: Hall anomaly by vacancies in pinned lattice of vortices: A quantitative analysis on the thin-film data of BSCCO
arxiv-2206-03384.creator: Ruonan Guo, Yong-Cong Chen, Ping Ao
arxiv-2206-03384.description: Abstract Hall anomaly, as appears in the mixed-state Hall resistivity of type-II superconductors, has had numerous theories but yet a consensus on its origin. In this work, we conducted a quantitative analysis of the magnetotransport measurements on BSCCO thin films by Zhao et al. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 122, 247001 (2019)] and validate a previously proposed vacancy mechanism [cf. J. Phys.

arxiv-2211-09782.title: Assessing Neural Network Robustness via Adversarial Pivotal Tuning
arxiv-2211-09782.creator: Peter Ebert Christensen, Vésteinn Snæbjarnarson, Andrea Dittadi, Serge Belongie, Sagie Benaim
arxiv-2211-09782.description: Abstract The robustness of image classifiers is essential to their deployment in the real world. The ability to assess this resilience to manipulations or deviations from the training data is thus crucial. These modifications have traditionally consisted of minimal changes that still manage to fool classifiers, and modern approaches are increasingly robust to them.

arxiv-2306-12808.title: The theory of electromagnetic line waves
arxiv-2306-12808.creator: S. A. R. Horsley, A. Dwivedi
arxiv-2306-12808.description: Abstract Whereas electromagnetic surface waves are confined to a planar interface between two media, line waves exist at the one–dimensional interface between three materials. Here we derive a non–local integral equation for computing the properties of line waves, valid for surfaces characterised in terms of a general tensorial impedance.

arxiv-2311-16174.title: Compact Modeling and Rapid Simulation of Silicon Photonic Micro-Disk and Ring Modulators
arxiv-2311-16174.creator: Vishal Saxena and Md Jubayer Shawon
arxiv-2311-16174.description: Abstract Microdisk or microring modulators (MDMs or MRMs) realize compact electro-optic modulation in active silicon photonics (SiP) foundry platforms. A key advantage of these resonant modulators is that they readily implement dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) in optical interconnects by tuning and locking the MDMs/MRMs to the DWDM wavelength grid.

arxiv-2408-07928.title: Time correlations in the inverse-gamma polymer with flat initial condition
arxiv-2408-07928.creator: Xiao Shen
arxiv-2408-07928.description: Abstract Temporal correlations in the KPZ universality class have gained significant attention, following the conjectures in [ 16 ] . Building on prior work in the zero temperature setting [ 5 ] , we address the time correlation problem with flat initial conditions in the positive temperature regime.

arxiv-2411-12959.title: Magnetic-thermodynamic phase transition in strained phosphorous-doped graphene
arxiv-2411-12959.creator: Natalia Cortés, J. Hernández-Tecorralco, L. Meza-Montes, R. de Coss, Patricio Vargas
arxiv-2411-12959.description: Abstract We explore quantum-thermodynamic effects in a phosphorous (P)-doped graphene monolayer subjected to biaxial tensile strain. Introducing substitutional P atoms in the graphene lattice generates a tunable spin magnetic moment controlled by the strain control parameter ε \varepsilon . This leads to a magnetic quantum phase transition (MQPT) at zero temperature modulated by ε \varepsilon .

arxiv-2502-12576.title: A Fuzzy Evaluation of Sentence Encoders on Grooming Risk Classification
arxiv-2502-12576.creator: Geetanjali Bihani, Julia Rayz
arxiv-2502-12576.description: Abstract With the advent of social media, children are becoming increasingly vulnerable to the risk of grooming in online settings. Detecting grooming instances in an online conversation poses a significant challenge as the interactions are not necessarily sexually explicit, since the predators take time to build trust and a relationship with their victim.

arxiv-2510-24716.title: Positive Feedback Drives Sharp Swelling of Polymer Brushes near Saturation
arxiv-2510-24716.creator: Simon Schubotz, Eva Bittrich, Holger Merlitz, Quinn A. Besford, Petra Uhlmann, Jens-Uwe Sommer, Günter K. Auernhammer
arxiv-2510-24716.description: Abstract We resolve the Schröder paradox for PNiPAAm brushes, showing experimentally that swelling at 100% relative humidity (RH) matches the liquid state. This occurs via a sharp increase in swelling above 98% RH, a behavior standard models fail to explain.

arxiv-2511-01976.title: Stability of mixed-state phases under weak decoherence
arxiv-2511-01976.creator: Yifan F. Zhang, Sarang Gopalakrishnan
arxiv-2511-01976.description: Abstract We prove that the Gibbs states of classical, and commuting-Pauli, Hamiltonians are stable under weak local decoherence: i.e., we show that the effect of the decoherence can be locally reversed. In particular, our conclusions apply to finite-temperature equilibrium critical points and ordered low-temperature phases. pmc-11488472.title: Universal neural networks for real-time earthquake early warning trained with generalized earthquakes
pmc-11488472.creator: Xiong Zhang, Miao Zhang
pmc-11488472.description: Deep learning enhances earthquake monitoring capabilities by mining seismic waveforms directly. However, current neural networks, trained within specific areas, face challenges in generalizing to diverse regions. Here, we employ a data recombination method to create generalized earthquakes occurring at any location with arbitrary station distributions for neural network training.

pmc-11500134.title: Physicochemical Properties of Seed Oil Blends and Their Potential for the Creation of Synthetic Oleosomes with Modulated Polarities
pmc-11500134.creator: Brett
pmc-11500134.description: There is an increasing demand within the pharmaceutical and cosmetic industries for biofriendly lipid-based active ingredient delivery systems. Micelles, liposomes, and lipid nanoparticles are currently the most used systems despite their limitations. Oleosomes, also known as lipid droplets, are promising alternatives to the existing strategies.

pmc-12577997.title: Pathophysiological role and clinical applications of HER-2 expression in meningiomas: a systematic review
pmc-12577997.creator: Ruchit Jain, Ismail Bozkurt, Mateus Gonçalves de Sena Barbosa, Vinícius Otávio da Silva, Inibehe Ime Okon, Kodeeswaran M, Priyadashan KP, Giuseppe Emanuele Umana, Mohammad Mohsin Khan, Mohsin Fayaz, Eberval Gadelha Figueiredo, Nazmin Ahmed, Bipin Chaurasia
pmc-12577997.description: Background:Although typically benign, malignant meningiomas represent 1–3% of cases and exhibit poor survival rates. Environmental and genetic risk factors, including neurofibromatosis type 2 (NF2), obesity, and hormone-related exposure, influence meningioma development.Objective:This study investigated HER2 expression in meningiomas, exploring its potential as a therapeutic target and examining its role in tumor pathophysiology and grade progression.

pmc-13081309.title: Surgical resection for sarcoma in the super-elderly: postoperative outcomes and clinical implications
pmc-13081309.creator: Masanori Kawano, Yuta Kubota, Ichiro Itonaga, Nobuhiro Kaku, Kazuhiro Tanaka
pmc-13081309.description: ObjectiveJapan is one of the most rapidly aging societies worldwide, and the incidence of rare malignancies such as sarcoma is expected to rise among the very elderly. Chronological age often influences treatment decisions, but such bias may deprive patients of optimal management. Clarifying treatment outcome and prognostic factors in this population is essential for evidence-based treatment strategies.

pmc-13146404.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2203 ENDOVASCULAR STROKE TREATMENT PERFORMED BY INTERVENTIONAL CARDIOLOGISTS: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS
pmc-13146404.creator: Anna Podlasek, Ka Yow, Wei Wei, Aloysius Leow, Piotr Musialek, Iris Grunwald, Jacopo Imberti, Gregory Lip, Benjamin Yq Tan
pmc-13146404.description: Background and aimsEndovascular stroke therapy (EST) is a level 1A, time-critical intervention for acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Despite compelling evidence of benefit, worldwide access remains below 5% of eligible patients. Interventional cardiologists (ICs) have increasingly contributed to EST delivery and this systematic review and meta analysis aims to compare their results against guidelines.

pmc-13226649.title: Passive seismological approaches for localizing near-surface fiber-optic cables with DAS
pmc-13226649.creator: Georg Rümpker, Fabian Limberger, Abolfazl Komeazi
pmc-13226649.description: Accurate knowledge of fiber-optic cable geometry is important for many applications of distributed acoustic sensing (DAS). However, the true positions of buried or installed fibers are often uncertain due to slack, bends, or deviations from documented routes. We present two passive, seismology-based approaches for cable localization that exploit information contained in DAS recordings.

pmc-13263963.title: Safely targeting combination TNF and IL-23 using a gut-restricted and orally delivered therapeutic approach: proof-of-concept for the development of SOR102 in ulcerative colitis

pmc-13312072.title: Histomorphologic characteristics of abdominal aortic aneurysm samples are similar in abdominal-only vs thoracoabdominal involvement
pmc-13312072.creator: Marvin Kapalla, Heiner Nebelung, Anna Klimova, Anja Hofmann, Nadja Sachs, Albert Busch, Maja Carina Nackenhorst
pmc-13312072.description: The abdominal aorta is the most frequent site of aneurysm development including mostly localized abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAAs) but also more extensive pathologies like thoracoabdominal aneurysms (TAAAs). This study compares histologic features including inflammation, fibrosis, and angiogenesis in samples from the abdominal aneurysm wall from patients with AAAs (n = 272) and TAAAs (n = 24) after open repair.

pmc-13628984.title: Assessing the feasibility of indoor air quality monitoring in low-income housing among Black adults with uncontrolled asthma in New York City
pmc-13628984.creator: Maureen George, Rhea K. Khurana, Jean-Marie Bruzzese, Marija Zeremski, Emily DiMango, Aisha Naseem, Andrea Cassells, Eunice Mak, Natalie Benda, Jonathan N. Tobin, Steven Chillrud
pmc-13628984.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundIndoor air quality (IAQ) plays a critical role in respiratory health, particularly among individuals with asthma. This study evaluated the feasibility of collecting and characterizing IAQ in the homes of Black adults with uncontrolled asthma in New York City.MethodsHome environmental audits were conducted at the time that ultrasonic personal air sampling (UPAS v2+) devices were deployed, which continuously collected both time-resolved and integrated air samples over an initial target runtime of two-weeks based on the amp-hours of the external battery.

pmc-2563014.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). Random community genomes (metagenomes) are now commonly used to study microbes in different environments.
